steps.title: Prepare Complete Macrophage Media
steps.instruction: Prepare complete macrophage media consisting of DMEM F12 HG supplemented with 10% foetal bovine serum (FBS) and 1% appropriate selection antibiotics (e.g., penicillin-streptomycin-glutamate [PSG] or others if bacteria are resistant to kanamycin and ampicillin).

substeps.instruction: Store media at 4 °C
Warm to 37 °C before use in assay

steps.title: Seed Macrophage Cells
steps.instruction: Perform all steps until microscope analysis in a Biosafety Class II Cabinet. Seed RAW264.7 macrophage cells onto 18mm diameter glass coverslips in a 12 well plate.

substeps.instruction: Seed 5x10^4 cells/well (500µL cells per well supplemented with 1mL of fresh complete macrophage media)
Seed 4 wells per cell type, including the control
Incubate overnight in a 37 °C/5% CO2 incubator

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Culture
steps.instruction: Grow overnight cultures of GFP labelled E. coli the day before the phagocytosis experiment.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 100µL stock into 100mL Luria Broth (5g/L yeast extract + 5g/L NaCl + 10g/L peptone/tryptone + 1L milli Q water, autoclaved) with appropriate selection antibiotics (100mg/L ampicillin and 50mg/L kanamycin added after cooling)
Grow at 37 °C in a shaking incubator to an OD 600 of 1 (~10^8 cells/mL)
Store at 4 °C

steps.title: Induce Bacterial Log-Phase Growth
steps.instruction: Three hours before planned macrophage inoculation, sub-culture the overnight bacterial culture to ensure early log-phase.

substeps.instruction: Mix 1mL overnight culture with 9mL fresh Ab free LB
Induce cultures with 10% arabinose/100mM IPTG (~200µL/10mL bacterial culture) at 37 °C in a shaking incubator
Ensure final concentrations are 0.02% arabinose and 2mM IPTG

steps.title: Harvest and Resuspend Bacteria
steps.instruction: Pellet the bacterial cells by centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Spin down bacterial culture for 5 minutes at 13,000g
Resuspend in an appropriate amount of 1x PBS based on required final concentration and assay volume

steps.title: Inoculate Macrophages with Bacteria
steps.instruction: Introduce the bacterial culture to the macrophage wells.

substeps.instruction: Remove existing macrophage media from the wells
Replace with 500µL fresh media
Supplement GFP E. coli at a ratio of 10 cells/macrophage (~10^6 cells/mL, add 1mL), excluding control wells
Ensure final volume is 1.5mL (1 mL bacterial culture and 500µL fresh complete macrophage media), resulting in approximately 10^5 macrophages and 10^6 bacteria per mL

steps.title: Co-incubate Cells
steps.instruction: Co-incubate cells at 37 °C/5% CO2 to allow for bacterial uptake for 1, 8, 24, 48 hours (or other specified time intervals).

steps.title: Stop Phagocytosis and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Halt the phagocytosis process and remove non-adherent bacteria.

substeps.instruction: Add 550µL ice-cold PBS to the well
Aspirate supernatant using a pipette
Wash cells three times with cold PBS (1mL/wash)

steps.title: Prepare Slides for Analysis
steps.instruction: Mount the coverslips onto microscope slides.

substeps.instruction: Transfer coverslips to a microscope slide with a drop of PBS (~6µL) using tweezers, ensuring the macrophage-attached side is face down
Seal microscope slides using clear nail polish and allow to dry

steps.title: Analyze Cells via Fluorescence Microscopy
steps.instruction: Use an upright fluorescent microscope (Leica DM5500B) to determine bacterial phagocytosis.

substeps.instruction: Set microscope to 63x oil objective, green fluorescent protein (GFP)- differential interference contrast (DIC) combination channel
Capture images using Leica DFC300 FC microscope camera and LAS V3 (version 3.2.0) software
Image 15 macrophages per coverslip across 4 replicates (60 macrophages total per treatment per time point)
